main_body: desert building with flat roof and turquoise dome
top_band: light sandy tan flat roof terrace with parapet and dome, rows 2-33
evidence: Rows 2-33 show the horizontal flat roof surface seen from above (bounded by a sunken parapet wall and holding a turquoise dome), with a lighter front edge at row 32, an overhang shadow at rows 34-36, and the brick front wall with recessed arched doorway and window from rows 34-63.

style.evidence: Uses material-toned outlines and 5-6 shading steps across sand, brick, wood, and turquoise dome, with stippled sand texture on the roof; However, the large brick blocks, clean white arch trim, and geometric dome look somewhat simpler and less intricately detailed than the dense Beodeul stone and roof-tile references.
